attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry names all four of its members, so it is one folder per named member and each relates the others. The corpus keeps a `vincent-of-spain`; that is another entry on another day and another man, and nothing on this page joins them. The English form here follows the Greek Βικέντιος rather than the Latin Vincent, so that the two are not confused. No year, so no `dates` object. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
